title: 第288章 我来第287章 无耻如斯
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“…………”
就连顾铮，此刻也感到十分无语。
他见过脸皮厚的，但厚到这种程度的，还真是头一回遇见。
自己那番话已经说得相当难听了，换做任何一位有头有脸的高手，就算不当场翻脸，至少也该面色不悦。
可这老泥鳅倒好，不但不生气，反而笑嘻嘻地接住了他的话茬，仿佛真的在跟他讨论做弓的材料问题。
这脸皮，怕是连武圣的刀都砍不穿。
就在这时，敖言溪终于开口了。
她的声音不高，却清清楚楚地传遍了整座大殿，每一个字都像是淬了冰渣子，冷得让人脊背发寒：“老泥鳅，你是不是在水底待得太久，脑子泡坏了？还是说，你那条细细长长的脑仁儿，全长成了脸皮？我活了这么多年，见过癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉的，但像你这样连自己几斤几两都掂不清的，还真是头一回见。”
她站起身来，目光居高临下地扫过龙君，嘴角挂着一抹毫不掩饰的讥讽：“你以为，凭你这条连龙门都没摸到的老蛟，也配觊觎真龙血脉？你在本宫眼里，跟一条泥鳅没什么区别，无非是条活得久一点的泥鳅罢了。你在这白波湖称王称霸惯了，便真以为自己有资格染指真龙了？可笑。你那点道行，在我面前，连提鞋都不配。”
她顿了顿，声音愈发冰冷：“还想双修？你也不撒泡尿照照自己，你配么？本宫就算是去找一条野狗双修，也比找你这老泥鳅强上百倍。至少野狗还知道摇尾巴，而你，只知道在这儿做你的春秋大梦。”
满堂死寂。
敖言溪那番话，字字如刀，句句带刺，换作任何一位稍有血性的高手，此刻怕是已经暴跳如雷、拔刀相向了。
满堂宾客屏息凝神，等待着龙君的爆发。
然而龙君只是静静地站在那里，脸上甚至没有一丝怒意。
他听完敖言溪那番极尽羞辱的话语，反而轻轻摇了摇头，嘴角依然挂着那副从容不迫的微笑，语气温和得仿佛在哄一个闹脾气的小女孩：“骂够了？骂够了就好。娘子性情刚烈，本君很是欣赏。不过没关系，本君活了这么多年，什么难听的话没听过？你这些话，对本君来说，不过是清风拂面罢了。”
他负手而立，目光中带着一种近乎宠溺的宽容：“娘子现在不理解本君的心意，不要紧。等成了亲，日子久了，你自然会明白本君对你的真心。本君有的是耐心，也有的是时间。”
龙君的目光从敖言溪身上移开，落在了顾铮身上。他上下打量了顾铮一番，眼中带着一种审视的意味，随即露出一个意味深长的笑容，开口道：“年轻人，本君知道你是谁。”
他缓步朝顾铮走近了两步，语气中带着一种居高临下的赞赏：“你是娘子的心上人，对吧？不错，身为人族，却能赢得一位真龙血脉的欢心，这可不是什么人都能做到的事。
本君活了这么久，见过的人杰不少，但能做到这一点的，你是头一个。
单凭这一点，本君佩服你。”

他顿了顿，脸上的笑容愈发耐人寻味：“不过你也不必着急。本君方才说过了，本君所求的，是与娘子双修一次，借此窥探化龙的门径。至于双修之后，娘子心中装着谁、要与谁在一起，本君并不在意。你大可放心，本君不介意你们继续在一起。”
这话一出，满堂宾客的神色变得更加精彩了。
有人面面相觑，有人低声窃窃私语，这龙君的脸皮，当真是厚到了一种令人叹为观止的境界。他不仅要抢人家的女人，还要让人家继续留在那女人身边，仿佛这一切都是他给予的恩赐一般。
龙君见敖言溪那副冷若冰霜的模样，倒也不急，反而悠然一笑，仿佛一切尽在掌握之中。他负手踱了两步，缓缓开口道：“娘子似乎心中不愿。也罢，本君向来不喜欢强人所难，本君希望娘子是心甘情愿的。这样吧，本君给你一个机会。”
他停下脚步，转过身来，目光落在敖言溪身上，嘴角噙着一抹自信的笑容：“娘子若能在本君手下撑过一炷香的时间，本君便就此罢休，放娘子离去，绝不再纠缠。如何？”
此言一出，满堂宾客的目光都聚焦在了敖言溪身上。
论境界，龙君与敖言溪其实处在同一个大境界上，都等同于人类武道中的神意境。
然而，同样是神意境，差距却可以大到天壤之别。
敖言溪属于初入神意，境界虽到，底蕴尚浅；而龙君却是一只脚已经踏入化龙门槛的存在，换算成人类的武道境界，便是一只脚已经跨入了武圣的门槛。
这两者之间的差距，绝非简单的境界相同可以弥补的。
敖言溪冷笑一声，声音如同冰棱坠地：“不必费尽心思了。癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，也不看看自己配不配。”
她顿了顿，语气中带着一股毫不掩饰的轻蔑，他既然敢踏入这泥鳅洞，自然不是不知天高地厚。他不会没有准备就来赴你这鸿门宴？
她这话并非虚张声势。身为龙岛之主最宠爱的女儿，她身上怎么可能没有几道保命的底牌？真要撕破脸皮，谁生谁死还说不准呢。
然而，就在她话音落下的那一刻，一个沉稳的声音忽然在她身旁响起。
“我来。”
敖言溪微微一怔，转头看向说话的顾铮。两人的目光在空中交汇，顾铮没有回避她的视线，只是沉声道：“相信我。”
敖言溪看着他，沉默了片刻。她能看到他眼中的坚定，那是一种不容置疑的决心。
她张了张嘴，想要说些什么，但最终还是选择了沉默，微微点了点头。
龙君负手而立，神情微妙地看着这一幕，目光在顾铮身上停留了片刻，嘴角勾起一抹玩味的笑容：“你？？？”
他轻轻摇了摇头，语气中带着一丝毫不掩饰的轻蔑。

在他感知中，他的气息比起敖言溪来，可是弱了不止一筹。
content_en:
"…………"
Even Gu Zheng felt speechless at this moment.
He had seen thick-skinned people before, but this was the first time he had seen someone so thick-skinned.
What he said was quite unpleasant. If it were any respectable expert, even if he didn't fall out on the spot, he would at least look unhappy.
But this old loach was good. Not only was he not angry, but he caught his words with a smile, as if he was really discussing the materials for making bows with him.
I'm afraid even the Martial Saint's sword wouldn't be able to cut through his face.
At this moment, Ao Yanxi finally spoke.
Her voice was not high, but it spread clearly throughout the entire hall. Every word was like quenched ice slag, so cold that it sent chills down the spine: "Old Loach, have you stayed under the water for too long and your brain has been damaged? Or is it? "Say, your long and thin brain has turned into skin? In all my years of living, I have seen a toad want to eat swan meat, but this is the first time I have seen someone like you who can't even weigh how much you weigh."
She stood up and glanced at Lord Long condescendingly, with an undisguised sarcasm hanging from the corner of her mouth: "Do you think that you, an old dragon who has never even touched the Dragon Gate, are qualified to covet the blood of the true dragon? In my eyes, you are just like a piece of clay. There is no difference between the loach and the loach. It’s just a loach that has lived longer. You are used to being the king of Baibo Lake, so you really think you are qualified to touch the real dragon? It’s ridiculous. You are not worthy of holding a shoe in front of me.”
She paused, and her voice became colder: "You still want to practice dual cultivation? You don't take a pee and take care of yourself, are you worthy? Even if I find a wild dog to cultivate dual cultivation, it is a hundred times better than finding an old loach like you. At least the wild dog still knows how to wag its tail, and you only know how to dream of your spring and autumn dreams here."
The whole hall was dead silent.
Ao Yanxi's words, every word was like a knife, and every sentence was thorny. If it were any master with a little bit of blood, he would probably be furious at this moment and draw his sword at him.
The guests in the hall held their breath, waiting for the Dragon Lord to explode.
However, Long Jun just stood there quietly, without even a hint of anger on his face.
After listening to Ao Yanxi's extremely humiliating words, he shook his head slightly, with that calm smile still hanging on his lips, and his tone was as gentle as if he was coaxing a little girl who was having a tantrum: "Enough scolding? Enough scolding is enough. I admire your lady's strong temperament. But it doesn't matter, I have lived for so many years, what unpleasant words have I not heard? Your words are just a breeze to me."
He stood with his hands behind his hands, with an almost doting tolerance in his eyes: "It doesn't matter if my wife doesn't understand my feelings now. When we get married, as time goes by, you will naturally understand my sincerity towards you. I have plenty of patience and time."
Long Jun's eyes moved away from Ao Yanxi and fell on Gu Zheng. He looked Gu Zheng up and down, with a look of scrutiny in his eyes, then showed a meaningful smile and said, "Young man, I know who you are."
He slowly took two steps closer to Gu Zheng, with a condescending admiration in his tone: "You are my lady's sweetheart, right? Yes, as a human being, being able to win the favor of a true dragon bloodline is not something that just anyone can do.
I have lived for so long and have met many outstanding people, but you are the first one who can do this.
For this reason alone, I admire you. "
He paused, and the smile on his face became more intriguing: "But you don't have to worry. I just said that what I want is to practice double cultivation with my wife once, so as to get a glimpse of the way to transform into a dragon. As for who the lady has in mind and who she wants to be with after the double cultivation, I don't care. You can rest assured that I don't mind if you continue to be together."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of the guests in the hall became even more exciting.
Some people looked at each other, somePeople whispered, this Dragon Lord's face was really thick to an astonishing level. Not only does he want to steal someone else's woman, but he also wants to let her stay with that woman, as if all this is a gift from him.
When Long Jun saw Ao Yanxi's frosty look, he was not in a hurry. Instead, he smiled leisurely, as if he had everything under control. He took two steps with his hands behind his back and said slowly: "My wife seems unwilling. Anyway, I don't like to force others to do things. I hope that my wife is willing. So, I will give you a chance."
He stopped, turned around, his eyes fell on Ao Yanxi, with a confident smile on his lips: "If the lady can survive a stick of incense in my hands, I will give up and let her go, and I will never bother you again. How about that?"
As soon as these words came out, the eyes of all the guests in the hall were focused on Ao Yanxi.
In terms of realm, Long Jun and Ao Yanxi are actually in the same realm, and they are both equivalent to the divine realm in human martial arts.
However, for the same divine artistic conception, the gap can be vastly different.
Ao Yanxi was the first to enter the Divine Will, and although he had reached the realm, his background was still shallow; while Longjun was a being who had already stepped into the threshold of transforming into a dragon. When converted into human martial arts realm, he had already stepped into the threshold of a martial saint with one foot.
The gap between the two cannot be bridged simply by having the same realm.
Ao Yanxi sneered, her voice like ice falling to the ground: "There's no need to go to all the trouble. A toad wants to eat swan meat, but it doesn't even look at whether it's worthy of it."
She paused, with an undisguised contempt in her tone. Since he dared to step into this loach cave, he certainly didn't know the heights of the world. Wouldn't he come to your Hongmen Banquet without preparation?
She wasn't bluffing. As the most beloved daughter of the Lord of Dragon Island, how could she not have a few life-saving trump cards? If we really want to fight, we can't tell who will live and who will die.
However, the moment she finished speaking, a steady voice suddenly sounded beside her.
"I'll do it."
Ao Yanxi was slightly startled and turned to look at Gu Zheng who was speaking. Their eyes met in the air, and Gu Zheng did not avoid her gaze, but said solemnly: "Trust me."
Ao Yanxi looked at him and was silent for a moment. She could see the firmness in his eyes, an unquestionable determination.
She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end she chose silence and nodded slightly.
Long Jun stood with his hands behind his hands, watching this scene with a subtle expression. His eyes stayed on Gu Zheng for a moment, and a playful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth: "You???"
He shook his head slightly, with a hint of undisguised contempt in his tone.
In his perception, his aura was much weaker than Ao Yanxi's.
